heading: Command caution indicator (informational only)
unknown_reason: The command's effects cannot be determined from its launch arguments.
runtime: Launches an interpreter or script; contents and downstream effects are not inspected.
nested: Runs a shell command or script supplied in launch arguments.
encoded: Encoded or indirect command content limits review visibility.
system: Invokes a system-management utility; effects depend on its options.
git_danger: Launch arguments resemble a potentially destructive or remote Git operation.
destructive: Visible launch arguments contain a potentially destructive operation.
disclaimer: This is not a safety verdict, permission check, or guarantee. Review the COMPLETE original command and arguments. An unseen script or dependency may have other effects.
